==Description==
The '''Gunslinger Charm''' is an exclusive [[charms|charm]] introduced as part of a merchandise launch. It could be obtained by purchasing the [[Gunslinger Mini Plush]] while it was sold.

==Appearance==
The '''Gunslinger Charm''' appearance is the same as the [[Gunslinger Mini Plush]]. It plays a short squeak when placed down.

The color of the charm never changes.

==Trivia==
*The '''Gunslinger Charm''' charm is one of the few charms that were 3D scanned into the game instead of modelled.
**This goes the same with the other plushie charms.
*Interestingly, its inventory description refer to the [[Gunslinger]] as '''Gun Slinger'''.

==Update History==
*'''26 May 2023''' - [[v1.7.5]]
**'''Gunslinger Charm''' added.
*'''2 June 2023'''
**'''Gunslinger Charm''' is no longer obtainable.
